title: Authentication failures (HTTP 401)

steps.title: Check whether failures come from a few clients
steps.description: Group the failures by client_id; a few clients suggests bad credentials or credential stuffing, many suggests a platform issue.

steps.title: Verify the identity provider and token signing keys
steps.description: Check identity-provider health and whether signing keys or certificates rotated recently.

steps.title: Check clock skew between services
steps.description: Token validation fails when host clocks drift; compare NTP status on affected hosts.

steps.title: Temporarily block or throttle abusive clients
steps.description: If a small set of clients produces most failures, rate-limit or block them.

escalation: Security on-call if a credential-stuffing pattern is suspected.
